raw_response: {"diagnosis": "A new 'v2' collector appeared starting with batch 12 (2026-01-17 delivery). Its txn_ts values look shifted by +6 hours compared with legacy rows: legacy days start around 06:00 local, while v2 days start around 12:00. This pushes late-evening v2 transactions into 00:00-06:00 of the next day, which explains the spurious 2026-01-19 rows and the off-hours counts. The likely cause is that v2 reports UTC while the business-local zone is UTC-6; this offset is inferred from the data, not confirmed by a change note.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
